north_star: Dropped attachments always use the link or embed syntax the user expects for that extension.
target_user: People who keep PDFs and office files as references but want images and media embedded inline.
core_promise: Preserve native attachment handling and change only the leading embed marker for configured extensions.
principles: Use public APIs and DOM surfaces only.
Let the app own attachment storage, naming, destination, and link format.
Rewrite only text inserted by the current drop.
Keep unknown extensions on native default behavior.
Prove behavior in a disposable Windows-local test vault.
success_metrics: PDF drops produce non-embedded links under defaults.
Common image drops produce embeds under defaults.
Community preflight and runtime smoke pass before release.
